WORD = lambda n: re.compile(r"(?<![\w$-])%s(?![\w$-])" % re.escape(n))
def strip(m):

    return "" if not kept else "import { %s } from %s;%s" % (", ".join(kept), m.group(2), m.group(3))
def reverse(text):
    text = re.sub(r'import \{([^}]*)\} from ("(?:\./|(?:\.\./)+editor/format/)testkit");(\n?)', strip, text)
    for a, b in BACK:
        text = WORD(a).sub(b, text)
    return text
def norm(t):
    """Formatting-blind outside strings and comments: whitespace dropped, a trailing comma before a closer dropped."""
    out, i, n = [], 0, len(t)
    while i < n:
        c = t[i]
        if c in "\"'`":
            j = i + 1
            while j < n and t[j] != c:
                j += 2 if t[j] == "\\" else 1
            out.append(t[i:j + 1])
            i = j + 1
        elif t.startswith("//", i):
            j = t.find("\n", i)
            j = n if j < 0 else j
            out.append(re.sub(r"\s+", "", t[i:j]))
            i = j
        elif t.startswith("/*", i):
            j = t.find("*/", i + 2)
            j = n if j < 0 else j + 2
            out.append(re.sub(r"\s+", "", t[i:j]))
            i = j
        elif c.isspace():
            i += 1
        else:
            out.append(c)
            i += 1
    return re.sub(r",(?=[)\]}>])", "", "".join(out))

        continue
    subs, added = NAMED.get(f, ([], None))
    want = old

            bad.append(f"{f}: named edit {a!r} not found once at the merge-base")
        want = want.replace(a, b)
    got = reverse(new) if f in FILES else new
